Stochastic but real, and worse than claimed. 5 runs of the constant-column repro (PPCA init is unseeded): 3x silent with [6,0] ~1.36-1.42; 1x the exact claimed 'WARN: PPCA EM did not converge within 500 iterations (last relative change nan, tol 0.0001)' with [6,0] -> 0.828428880743597 == column mean 0.8284288807436042; and 1x a hard crash 'numpy.linalg.LinAlgError: Singular matrix' at external/ppca.py:119 np.linalg.inv(np.eye(d) + CC/ss). The shipped gallery example reproduced the claim verbatim: 'UserWarning: PPCA EM did not converge within 500 iterations (last relative change nan, tol 0.0001); returning the current estimate.' Upgraded minor -> major: a zero-variance column can intermittently crash impute() outright, not just warn.

Reproduced exactly: 'RAISED: IndexError | boolean index did not match indexed array along axis 1; size of axis is 7 but size of corresponding boolean axis is 4'. Source confirms the documented ValueError (hypertools/impute/ppca.py lines 121-124, and Raises section lines 91-95) is unreachable for a different column count: line 120 evaluates original[:, valid] (size-4 boolean mask into 7 columns) inside the guard expression itself, raising IndexError before the ValueError can fire.

Confirmed by measurement and source. Measured: 'frac=0.1: observed exact: True, maxdiff 0.00e+00; frac=0.4: observed exact: True, maxdiff 0.00e+00'. Module docstring (hypertools/impute/ppca.py line 12) still says 'non-missing entries are NOT guaranteed to be preserved exactly', while the implementation (lines 129-137, comment 'SPLICE: keep every observed (non-NaN) value exactly') preserves them byte-identically. format_data.py:236 still warns 'Missing data: Inexact solution computed with PPCA (see https://github.com/allentran/pca-magic ...)' -- stale for the same reason.
